structural assets.functionality: It holds the registered decision that qualifies release of memory data on the response.
structural assets.justification: It is the in-unit register that directly makes the response-release decision and can block functional memory-read responses.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: It contributes to the value registered into rden. The request read/write control directly decides whether rden is asserted and can therefore block the response enable.
structural assets.functionality: It contributes to the value registered into rden.
structural assets.justification: The request read/write control directly decides whether rden is asserted and can therefore block the response enable.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: It contributes to the value registered into rden. The request strobe directly decides whether rden is asserted and can therefore prevent a response from being released.
structural assets.functionality: It contributes to the value registered into rden.
structural assets.justification: The request strobe directly decides whether rden is asserted and can therefore prevent a response from being released.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: It times registration of the response-enable decision. Stalling the clock can prevent rden from updating and thereby block the response operation.
structural assets.functionality: It times registration of the response-enable decision.
structural assets.justification: Stalling the clock can prevent rden from updating and thereby block the response operation.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: It clears rden through the reset arm of bus_feedback. Asserting the active-low reset forces the response-enable state low and can prevent memory data from being released.
structural assets.functionality: It clears rden through the reset arm of bus_feedback.
